evidence_identity_contract: The run_id and complete freeze_tuple apply to every reviewed case. Every SHA below is transcribed from this batch's owner-frozen final inventory input, not calculated locally. Each existing case JSON was statically read for its same run/source/binary and native-size declaration. Current C5 source was not used.
review_method: ui-ux-pro-max guidance and the already-read frozen Scribe scope/plan were applied. Every new assigned original PNG was opened with tools.view_image after static reads of its case, state, metadata, actions and log. Native captures are 930x1240 and physical references 1860x2480 at scale 2. Previously viewed references are explicitly reused below. No mechanical pass was substituted for image inspection. REMOTE_QUIET_NATIVE was observed: no program/test/build/probe/automatic verification, SSH, copy, hash, crop or image processing was performed.
capture_diagnostic_context: The final manifest declares mechanical_success=false and full_capture_suite_completed=false. Only the eight present assigned frames are assessed; their per-case mechanical results are retained without implying suite completion or a passing business flow.
